val sbox_lookup : (bits(8), vector(256, bits(8))) -> bits(8)

```
function sbox_lookup(x, table) = {

- `/* AES SubWord function used in the key expansion`

```
val aes_subword_fwd : bits(32) -> bits(32)

```

  aes_sbox_fwd(x[31..24]) @
  aes_sbox_fwd(x[23..16]) @

  aes_sbox_fwd(x[ 7.. 0])
